reason: v5 fresh_process_id is not a falsifiable process-epoch identity: it embeds the job key and uses a boot nonce generated inside each _child call. Two different jobs executed by the same OS process necessarily have different fresh_process_id strings because the job component differs, so the uniqueness check cannot detect worker reuse. The pair-level equality check has the same defect.

negative_control.setup: execute two synthetic v5 _child jobs sequentially in one interpreter process, then execute two synthetic v6 _child jobs after one v6 worker initializer in that same process

consequence: Do not issue or support a replay-determinism certificate from v5. Preserve v5 raw shards only as non-certifying diagnostic evidence. Do not retry or reuse any v5 attempt identity.

replacement.identity_fix: one random process epoch nonce is created by the Pool worker initializer and remains stable for that worker lifetime; process_epoch_id excludes job identity; any duplicate process_epoch_id across observations fails closed
